facts.fact: The WARCIP-Mauritania feasibility study (consultants Marpij, Neo Telecoms, Eric Veve; final version, June 2014) states that Mauritania has no exchange point yet: operators' traffic to each other is transit, not local peering, and Dakar in effect acts as the IXP for Mauritanian operators, Mauritel and Chinguitel traffic being exchanged there; the study proposes creating one.

systems.system: Mauritania IXP (proposed, single site at the IMT ACE landing station in Nouakchott, second site later at the Nouakchott datacenter building)
systems.platform: Layer 2 switch cluster with route servers (scenarios studied)
systems.tiers: Mauritel, Mattel, Chinguitel as expected members

note: Design study of a planned IXP, none operating; the study also says global content networks (Google, Akamai, Amazon, OVH) are totally absent from Mauritania.
